title: 1. Investigate
text: I dig into your ad account, tracking, CRM, positioning and sales conversations. Which accounts matter? What are they seeing today? Where is budget leaking?

title: 2. Improve
text: Before anything new, I fix the foundations: targeting, account lists, tracking, campaign structure and the ads already running. This alone often frees up budget and sharpens results.

title: 3. Ideate & create
text: With solid foundations, we build what’s new: fresh angles, company and thought-leader ads, structured creative tests. Then we keep what works, cut what doesn’t, and scale into pipeline.
